class.name: rqt_marine_control/MarineControl
class.description: Generic device-control panel for the bridgeable device-control contract: select a marine_control_interfaces/ControlSet state topic, view its controls, and change them over the bridge (publishes a ControlValue on the matching change topic). See unh_marine_autonomy ADR-0003.
